env.AVAILABLE_PLATFORMS: appletvos appletvsimulator driverkit iphoneos iphonesimulator macosx watchos watchsimulator xros xrsimulator
env.OTHER_LDFLAGS: -Wl,-headerpad_max_install_names -framework Foundation -framework UIKit -framework Metal -framework MetalKit -framework MetalPerformanceShaders -framework SpriteKit -framework QuartzCore -framework CoreGraphics -framework CoreText -framework CoreAudio -framework AudioToolbox -framework AVFoundation -framework GameController -framework ImageIO -framework MobileCoreServices -framework CoreHaptics
env.RUN_SCRIPT_PHASES:
[{"name":"Compile Asset Catalog","shell_path":"/bin/sh","shell_script":"echo '📦 Compiling asset catalog...'; 
"
                          "# Use actool to compile the asset catalog properly
"
                          "xcrun actool \
"
                          "  --compile \"/Users/aimac/Development/FloppyTurd/build_ios_new/assets\" \
"
                          "  --platform iphoneos \
"
                          "  --minimum-deployment-target 13.0 \
"
                          "  --app-icon AppIcon \
"
                          "  --output-partial-info-plist \"/Users/aimac/Development/FloppyTurd/build_ios_new/AssetInfo.plist\" \
"
                          "  --compress-pngs \
"
                          "  --enable-on-demand-resources YES \
"
                          "  \"/Users/aimac/Development/FloppyTurd/FloppyTurd/Assets.xcassets\" \
"
                          "  || { echo 'Asset catalog compilation failed!'; exit 1; }; 
"
"
                          "# Copy compiled assets to app bundle
"
                          "APP_PATH=\"\/\\"
"
                          "echo 'Copying processed assets to: '$APP_PATH; 
"
                          "mkdir -p \"$APP_PATH\" 
"
                          "cp -R \"/Users/aimac/Development/FloppyTurd/build_ios_new/assets/\"* \"$APP_PATH/\" 
"
"
                          "# Merge the partial Info.plist if it exists
"
                          "if [ -f \"/Users/aimac/Development/FloppyTurd/build_ios_new/AssetInfo.plist\" ]; then
"
                          "  echo 'Merging asset catalog info into Info.plist...'
"
                          "  plutil -insert CFBundleIcons -xml \"\" \"$APP_PATH/Info.plist\" || true
"
                          "  plutil -insert CFBundleIcons~ipad -xml \"\" \"$APP_PATH/Info.plist\" || true
"
                          "fi
"
"
                          "echo '✅ Asset catalog compilation and installation complete'"}]
